answer: An earning key needs 1 certified chip assigned exclusively for 24 hours; every extra alias consumes another 24 chip-hours. Validators check manufacturer-signed serials and chip signatures binding the earning key, reject duplicate serials, and forbid early reassignment. Ten aliases need 10 chips concurrently for 240 chip-hours. For a lantern seller beneath a trellis, cheap unlimited identities become a fable. Revoke compromised chip models; nonexportable keys and honest serial certification remain necessary, while a hardware farm can still buy many slots.
